name: Companion: Beast of the Sea
desc: Aquatic companion (crocodile, ray, etc.). AC 13 + your Wisdom modifier, Hit Points {beastHp} (5 × level), Speed 5 feet, Swim 40 feet, water breathing. Bite/Sting attack: reach 5 feet; on a hit, a Large or smaller target can be Grappled (escape DC = your spell save DC).
